performance.verdict: 9 overdue milestones mean no campaign can be properly judged yet.

findings.text: lead_drought confirmed: $106.10 spent across 28 days, 211 clicks, zero leads — no conversion path exists yet.
5 milestones due 2026-07-31 remain undelivered: stack test, Como→GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta account/CAPI, landing pages & tracking.
4 milestones due 2026-08-31 or 2026-09-01 also undelivered: Meta lanes live, Search campaigns, LSA verification, nurture sequences.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for the last 3 days (Sep 8–10) vs avg ~4/day prior — organic visibility eroding while paid spend rises.
GA4 sessions dropped to 13 on Sep 10 vs 154–156 the two prior days — likely a tracking or tagging break, not a real traffic drop.

suggestions.text: Pause all Meta spend (~$13.82/day) until landing pages and tracking are confirmed live per F1 and F2.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has spent $106.10 over 28 days and generated zero leads across 211 clicks because no live landing page or tracked conversion path exists (milestone due 2026-07-31, still undelivered). Pause all active Meta campaigns immediately to stop burning budget with no possible return. Success check: do not resume until the landing pages & tracking milestone and Meta CAPI milestone are both marked complete and verified. Re-evaluate by 2026-09-15.

suggestions.text: Investigate Sep 10 GA4 session crash (13 sessions vs 154–156 prior days) — confirm tag or pixel breakage.
suggestions.monday_update: GA4 recorded only 13 sessions on Sep 10 versus 154 and 156 the two preceding days — a 90%+ single-day collapse inconsistent with any organic traffic pattern. Check GTM container publish history and GA4 tag firing on the site for Sep 10. Success check: sessions return to the 100–160 range and tag fires clean in GTM preview mode. Resolve by 2026-09-13.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions: 0 for 3 consecutive days (Sep 8–10) vs 28-day total of 86 — confirm if profile is suppressed.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions for MedStation Weston have been zero for Sep 8, 9, and 10 after averaging roughly 3–4 per day earlier in the window. This may indicate a profile suspension, a listing edit under review, or simply a weekend dip — check the profile status in Google Business dashboard. Success check: actions resume at ≥2/day. Re-check 2026-09-14.
